list.name: sysid
list.label: System
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "dasd_volume" WITH KEY = "sysid"

list.name: storgrp
list.label: Storage group
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "dasd_volume" WITH KEY = "storgrp" WHERE "sysid" =~ /^$sysid$/

targets.query: SELECT last("volser") AS "volser", last("model") AS "model", last("pct_used") AS "pct_used", last("pct_free") AS "pct_free", last("capacity_kb") AS "capacity_kb", last("alloc_kb") AS "alloc_kb", last("free_kb") AS "free_kb", last("largest_free_ext_kb") AS "largest_free_ext_kb", last("frag_index") AS "frag_index", last("free_extents") AS "free_extents", last("free_dscbs") AS "free_dscbs", last("storage_group") AS "storage_group", last("devtype") AS "devtype", last("ixvtoc_enabled") AS "ixvtoc_enabled", last("collected_at") AS "collected_at", last("sys1_sms") AS "sys1_sms", last("sys1_mvs") AS "sys1_mvs", last("sys2_sms") AS "sys2_sms", last("sys2_mvs") AS "sys2_mvs", last("sys3_sms") AS "sys3_sms", last("sys3_mvs") AS "sys3_mvs", last("sys4_sms") AS "sys4_sms", last("sys4_mvs") AS "sys4_mvs", last("sys5_sms") AS "sys5_sms", last("sys5_mvs") AS "sys5_mvs", last("sys6_sms") AS "sys6_sms", last("sys6_mvs") AS "sys6_mvs", last("sys7_sms") AS "sys7_sms", last("sys7_mvs") AS "sys7_mvs", last("sys8_sms") AS "sys8_sms", last("sys8_mvs") AS "sys8_mvs", last("cylmg_capacity_kb") AS "cylmg_capacity_kb", last("cp_target_occ_pct") AS "cp_target_occ_pct", last("cp_trigger_occ_pct") AS "cp_trigger_occ_pct", last("cp_occ_after_pct") AS "cp_occ_after_pct", last("pct_used_trk") AS "pct_used_trk", last("pct_used_cyl") AS "pct_used_cyl", last("trk_capacity_kb") AS "trk_capacity_kb", last("trk_alloc_kb") AS "trk_alloc_kb", last("cylmg_alloc_kb") AS "cylmg_alloc_kb", last("conflict_error") AS "conflict_error", last("conflict_warning") AS "conflict_warning", last("mvs_offline") AS "mvs_offline", last("sms_disabled") AS "sms_disabled", last("sms_quiesced") AS "sms_quiesced", last("conflict_level") AS "conflict_level" FROM "dasd_volume" WHERE $timeFilter AND "sysid" =~ /^$sysid$/ AND "storgrp" =~ /^$storgrp$/ GROUP BY "devnum", "sysid"

SELECT last("type") AS "change_type", last("volser") AS "change_volser", last("storgrp") AS "change_storgrp", last("model") AS "change_model", last("systems") AS "change_systems", last("comment") AS "change_comment", last("user") AS "change_user", last("status") AS "change_status", last("created_at") AS "change_created", last("updated_at") AS "change_updated" FROM "dasd_change" GROUP BY "devnum"
SELECT mean("pct_used_exact") FROM "dasd_volume" WHERE $timeFilter AND "sysid" =~ /^$sysid$/ AND "storgrp" =~ /^$storgrp$/ GROUP BY time(1d), "storgrp" fill(none)
